items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: After the Bhote Koshi floods, search teams have recovered 734 bodies and rescued more than 8,000 people, including over 260 foreigners. About 2,500 remain unaccounted for, with operations still underway in the affected districts.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: NESRA FloodWatch — Rasuwa / Bhotekoshi situation brief
items.summary: Independent geospatial / satellite situational awareness page for the Rasuwa–Bhotekoshi–Trishuli flood. Not a government filing system and not a missing-persons registry. NESRA says follow DHM, NDRRMA and local authorities for official warnings. Useful for access, impact, and Earth-observation context.
items.citation: NESRA — FloodWatch Rasuwa 2026

items.source: Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers (OPMCM)
items.title: Rasuwa Flood Rescue Portal (OPMCM)
items.summary: Official Government of Nepal portal for the 2026 Bhote Koshi–Trishuli / Rasuwa flood response. Families can search missing and found reports, request help, browse help requests, and open emergency contacts. Run by the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers. This site links to the portal; we do not copy names or case details.
items.citation: OPMCM — rescue.opmcm.gov.np

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, and teams have recovered 626 bodies while more than 2400 people are still missing. Over 4450 people have been rescued so far, including 187 foreign nationals, with search efforts continuing in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading and Chitwan.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August, with 538 bodies recovered so far and 511 people still missing. Rescue teams are searching the area and helping those affected.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams and helicopters are working at the mudslide site in Gyirong Port after it hit Wednesday morning. Three people have been killed and 558 remain missing, with more rescuers and supplies arriving.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August. So far 359 bodies have been recovered and 596 people from 33 countries are still missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal has opened a help line for families of foreign nationals missing or affected in the Rasuwa floods. Call or message +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 from 7am to 10pm.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood

items.title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
items.summary: India's foreign ministry has opened a 24-hour control room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Contacts include the listed Delhi numbers and WhatsApp lines plus the Indian embassies in Kathmandu and Beijing.
items.citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation

items.title: NDRRMA rescue coordination portal
items.summary: Updates on the Bhotekoshi and Rasuwa flash flood are posted on the official rescue portal and SETU platform. Families can check those sites for the latest status instead of social media.
items.citation: NDRRMA — rescue portal (ndrrma.gov.np/np/rescue)

items.title: Nepal Police official found and missing lists
items.summary: Nepal Police keeps the main lists of people missing or found after the floods. Only they can confirm someone's status, not other sites or social media.
items.citation: Nepal Police UDB — udb.nepalpolice.gov.np

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary: The Indian embassy in Kathmandu is working with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals caught in the floods around Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi. Families can reach the Delhi control room or the embassy on WhatsApp for help.
items.citation: Embassy of India, Kathmandu

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River this morning, killing people and damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. So far 72 bodies have been recovered and 403 people from 25 countries are reported missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
